properties.title: GLiM
properties.description: The new global lithological map database GLiM, a representation of rock properties at the Earth surface.

table:columns.name: IDENTITY_
table:columns.description: Polygon identifier (region code + number, e.g. FJI232)

table:columns.name: Litho
table:columns.description: Lithology code: three 2-letter levels (main class, subclass, additional characteristics); '_' = not available

table:columns.name: xx
table:columns.description: First level lithological class (2-letter code, first level of Litho)

table:columns.name: Shape_Leng
table:columns.description: Polygon perimeter in the original EPSG:3857 CRS (m, not updated after reprojection)

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Polygon area in the original EPSG:3857 CRS (m2, not updated after reprojection)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>

data.title: GLiM
